metadata.qualityHypothesis: Only the selected plan's two birth base stats are set to ordinaryBase>=46 ? ordinaryBase : 46+(ordinaryBase%3), then the existing recruitment project is added. Already-good bases 46..48 are preserved; the guarantee never decreases either target stat. All other birth stats, height, bias, matchSeed and RNG are identical. No XP, direct level or guaranteed-template grant.
metadata.deterministicPairingCaveat: This is a deterministic paired shadow rule, not an implemented random recruitment. The 25 original bases 24..48 map into base 46/47/48 with counts 9/8/8 and mean 46.96; this slight nonuniformity is retained for pairing, not presented as a uniform random selected-recruitment implementation. Final production randomization would require a separate decision.
assumptions: Controlled G6 stage, not from-zero acquisition or adoption model
128 paired seeds per existing plan; basic cooperation accepted from birth, never switched
True newGym/recruit, original engine growth/matching and real recommendation ledger probes
Only two stats and entryStats are modified in the hypothetical selected branch
Same XP, CD, stamina, kit and RNG; exact same checkpoint shots/time verified for both branches
Selected fee is not actually debited; reported net is a hypothetical subtraction, not a payment-flow implementation
Any-height recruitment held identical; existing height groups are not changed
Template outcomes are actual checkpoint matches; level is not treated as a template guarantee
